description: List the saved workout library (`workouts`), the scheduled workouts (`upcoming_schedule`) and the races or events the user added or subscribed to (`upcoming_events`). Use it for "my next race", "what is planned this week" or "which workouts do I have", and to find a workout id or schedule_id. For the steps of one workout use get_workout, to put a workout on the calendar or take it off schedule_workouts, for sessions already done get_activities. `sport` and `limit` narrow only the library; `from` and `to` set only the calendar window: today and the next 60 days by default, any range up to 3 years, past or future. Calendar months not in the cache yet are downloaded on the way. In events `primary` marks the goal race of an active training plan.

from.description: Calendar start; default today (or 60 days before `to` when `to` is in the past)

sport.description: Only library workouts of this sport, e.g. running, cycling, strength_training

name: list_workouts
title: Workouts and calendar
